links.outcome: Multiple choice accuracy versus prose reasoning quality of LLMs on ophthalmology CME questions
links.effect: MC accuracy 82.5% (99/120) ChatGPT-4 and 49.2% (59/120) Gemini Pro 1.5; prose showed incorrect reasoning (42%, 58%), missing content (42%, 30%), and possible harm (36%, 44%).
links.quote: Though there was high evidence of correct reasoning in the prose responses (92% and 88% for ChatGPT-4 and Gemini Pro 1.5, respectively), there was also evidence of incorrect reasoning (42% and 58%), inappropriate content (29% and 36%), missing content (42% and 30%), and possibility of physical or emotional harm (36% and 44%).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance, completeness, and potential for harm of LLMs (ChatGPT-4 and Gemini Pro 1.5) on ophthalmology multiple-choice questions and prose responses, without testing an operational guardrail or deployment practice.
